def find_dissimilar(tup1, tup2):
    # Convert tuples to sets for efficient set operations
    set1 = set(tup1)
    set2 = set(tup2)
    
    # Find elements in either tuple but not both (symmetric difference)
    dissimilar_elements = sorted(list(set1.symmetric_difference(set2)))
    
    return tuple(dissimilar_elements)

def find_dissimilar(tup1, tup2):
    # Convert tuples to sets for efficient set operations
    set1 = set(tup1)
    set2 = set(tup2)
    
    # Find elements in either tuple but not both (symmetric difference)
    dissimilar_elements = sorted(list(set1.symmetric_difference(set2)))
    
    return tuple(dissimilar_elements)

# Test the function with the provided assertion case
assert find_dissimilar((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) == (3, 6, 7, 10)
print("Test passed successfully!")
